item.title: Rallying Cry – November 9, 2026
item.description: Nigeria’s Flamingos just won Africa’s first-ever U-17 World Cup title, Native American women made historic gains in the US midterms, Brisbane got its first live talk show thanks to a local creator, and a historic gurdwara in Lahore reopened for the first time since Partition.
